contract: Read the first packet before each backward seek and compare the landed video position and complete packet suffix.
Source sync seeks use sample composition time and demux seeks use the projected video clock. The reference uses the public backward MOV demux seek for the packet suffix.
A movie-time request inside an empty edit emits an empty mapping and no packets. The AV1 source seek compares the coded sync flag and traces the demuxer disposable assertion.
Compare track, PTS, DTS, duration, flags, size, payload, position, time base and encoded trim. Preserve every original range case, including start-up and Opus roll recovery.

For range playback compare the nonzero usable MovieHeaderBox duration in microseconds, or the maximum packet presentation endpoint of the playable tracks when the header has no usable duration. Preserve the reference stream-info estimate in the trace. Release seek checkpoints before the checkpoint control and compare the resulting seek.
Preload input outside the measurement window.

open_deviations.reading: A backward source seek has no preceding sync sample in the configuration
open_deviations.clause: ISO/IEC 14496-12:2015 sections 8.6.2 and 8.6.6 describe declared sync samples and edit preroll. Mp4SyncSeekJob requires a preceding sync sample in the target configuration.
open_deviations.candidate: Refuses the backward request with no MP4 sync in target configuration at source time 91091 ticks.
open_deviations.reference: Logs that it cannot find a preceding index entry, then starts at the first available video key with PTS 93093 and an audio prefix.
open_deviations.compat: compat::mov::seek_first_later_sync for consumers that recover with a later point instead of a strict backward seek.
